result.instructions: Tools for Salsa Engage, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which supporters changed their details in the last 7 days?"; "Show me the donations made this month and which template they used."; "Show the results of our last email blast.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Salsa Engage data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run salsa_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run salsa_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run salsa_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. salsa_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: salsa_get_call_metrics
tools.title: Get API call metrics
tools.description: Show the calls left in the current one-minute window for this token, the batch limit, and the call counters. Good first call to check the token works. Engage API: GET /integration/ext/v1/metrics.

tools.name: salsa_search_supporters
tools.title: Search supporters
tools.description: Find supporters by Salsa Engage supporter ID, by text (first name, last name, email or cell phone), or by the time their census data changed. Returns each supporter with address, contacts and per-record errors and warnings. Engage API: POST /integration/ext/v1/supporters/search.

identifiers.description: Salsa Engage supporter IDs (UUIDs), up to 20 per call.

searchString.description: Text to match in first name, last name, email or cell phone.

modifiedFrom.description: Only supporters whose census data changed on or after this UTC time.

offset.description: Items to skip. For the next page, send the previous offset plus the previous count.

count.description: Items to return: 1 to 20 (the token batch limit).

tools.name: salsa_get_supporter_groups
tools.title: Get supporter groups
tools.description: List the groups that each of the given supporters belongs to. Engage API: POST /integration/ext/v1/supporters/groups.

identifiers.description: Salsa Engage supporter IDs (UUIDs), up to 20 per call.

tools.name: salsa_search_transactions
tools.title: Search transactions
tools.description: Find donation transactions by transaction ID or supporter ID, or by a transaction date range. Pass identifiers with identifierType, or transactionFrom (with transactionTo). Engage API: POST /integration/ext/v1/transactionDetails/search.

identifiers.description: Transaction IDs or supporter IDs (UUIDs), up to 20 per call.

identifierType.description: Type of the identifiers. Required when identifiers are given.

offset.description: Items to skip. For the next page, send the previous offset plus the previous count.

count.description: Items to return: 1 to 20 (the token batch limit).

tools.name: salsa_search_activities
tools.title: Search activities
tools.description: Find supporter activity (signups, donations, petitions, letters, event registrations and similar) by activity ID, by form, by supporter, or by modified time. Pass modifiedFrom or activityIds. Engage API: POST /integration/ext/v1/activities/search.

activityIds.description: Activity UUIDs, up to 20 per call.

activityFormIds.description: Form UUIDs, up to 20 per call.

supporterIds.description: Salsa Engage supporter IDs (UUIDs), up to 20 per call.

type.description: Only this kind of form activity.

modifiedFrom.description: Only activity modified on or after this UTC time.

offset.description: Items to skip. For the next page, send the previous offset plus the previous count.

count.description: Items to return: 1 to 20 (the token batch limit).

tools.name: salsa_search_email_blasts
tools.title: Search email blasts
tools.description: Find sent email blasts by blast ID, content ID, or publish date. Use the returned cursor to read more. Engage API: POST /integration/ext/v1/emails/search.

type.description: Blast type. The reference documents EMAIL only.

publishedFrom.description: Published on or after this UTC time.

publishedTo.description: Published on or before this UTC time.

cursor.description: Cursor from an earlier reply, to read the next results.

offset.description: Items to skip. For the next page, send the previous offset plus the previous count.

count.description: Items to return: 1 to 20 (the token batch limit).

tools.name: salsa_get_email_blast_results
tools.title: Get email blast results
tools.description: Read the per-supporter results of one email blast (who received, opened or clicked it, as Engage reports them). Engage API: POST /integration/ext/v1/emails/individualResults.

contentId.description: Email content ID (UUID), when the blast has one.

type.description: Blast type. The reference documents EMAIL only.

cursor.description: Cursor from an earlier reply, to read the next results.

offset.description: Items to skip. For the next page, send the previous offset plus the previous count.

count.description: Items to return: 1 to 20 (the token batch limit).

tools.name: salsa_search_segments
tools.title: Search segments
tools.description: Get the definition of segments (supporter groups used for email targeting and export) by segment ID. Engage API: POST /integration/ext/v1/segments/search.

segmentIds.description: Segment UUIDs, up to 20 per call.

offset.description: Items to skip. For the next page, send the previous offset plus the previous count.

count.description: Items to return: 1 to 20 (the token batch limit).

tools.name: salsa_search_segment_members
tools.title: Search segment members
tools.description: List the supporters in one segment, optionally only some supporter IDs or those who joined since a time. Engage API: POST /integration/ext/v1/segments/members/search.

supporterIds.description: Salsa Engage supporter IDs (UUIDs), up to 20 per call.

joinedSince.description: Only members who joined the segment on or after this UTC time.

offset.description: Items to skip. For the next page, send the previous offset plus the previous count.

count.description: Items to return: 1 to 20 (the token batch limit).

tools.name: salsa_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the supporter and activity custom fields in this Engage organization, with their names and types. Use it before you write custom data. Engage API: GET /integration/ext/v1/customFields.

offset.description: Items to skip. For the next page, send the previous offset plus the previous count.

count.description: Items to return: 1 to 20 (the token batch limit).

tools.name: salsa_upsert_supporters
tools.title: Create or update supporters
tools.description: Create or update up to 20 supporters in one call. Give supporterId to update a known supporter. For a supporter without it, Engage decides the match, so check each result, errors and warnings in the reply. Engage API: PUT /integration/ext/v1/supporters.

supporterId.description: Salsa Engage supporter ID (UUID) of the record to update.

externalSystemId.description: Your own reference for this supporter (sent as externalSystemId).

gender.description: For example Male or Female, as the Engage census field allows.

state.description: Two-letter US state code (CA), or an ISO 3166-2 code elsewhere (NL-NH).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in capitals, for example US or NL.

contacts.description: Email addresses and phone numbers for the supporter.

supporters.description: Supporters to create or update, up to 20.
